reasons.claim: Even in a good year of 8 billion in profit, the current 179 billion market cap implies a P/E of 22-23, which is still risky and not undervalued.
reasons.quote: even if they reach 8 billion of profitability one day that is still just a p ratio of 22 23 somewhere down the road which makes even this risky

reasons.claim: Munger's view that every Disney business has gotten tougher means the old high-margin, dominant-franchise days are over.
reasons.quote: practically every business that Disney has has gotten tougher than it used to be

reasons.claim: Streaming is intensely competitive with six or seven well-funded rivals all fighting for the same subscribers and content, so profitability may never be durable, like the airline industry.
reasons.quote: it might look like the airlines industry where nobody never made money

reasons.claim: Net margins that used to be 15% during the great times are unlikely to return, permanently lowering the profitability the stock deserves to be valued on.
reasons.quote: this great times 15 net margins are likely over so we have to lower those net margins significantly

reasons.claim: Bob Iger's cocky, overconfident attitude in the earnings call, and his age, make Sven doubt he can turn the business around despite past M&A success.
reasons.quote: I just feel that Bob Iger is a little bit over his head here or he has been called back like the Savior but he's 72 years old
